title: Prevention of Custodial Torture Violence and Accountability Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal for absolute criminalization of custodial torture (mandatory 7 years to Life Imprisonment), statutory reversal of burden of proof, mandatory medical exam within 2 hours (D.K. Basu), and mandatory ₹25 Lakhs victim compensation.
notes: Matter 017: Prevention of Custodial Torture Violence and Accountability Bill, 2026.
